proofs.summary: The teaching operation detail browser smoke opens /teaching/invite-code, clicks Generate New Invite Code, holds audit readback as the 25th audit gate, verifies the new invite artifact is hidden while audit evidence is pending, then releases readback and requires the artifact/success state.

The production release gate now requires operationInviteArtifactAuditGated in teaching-operation-detail-browser-smoke results and blocks stale evidence with teaching-operation-detail-browser-smoke-results-not-proven when it is missing.
The smoke test runtime records 25 ordinary teaching operation calls and 25 audit readback calls, distinguishing main-page invite generation from operation-detail invite generation.
